name: log_watcher
title: Log Watcher
description: Inspect and manage the centralized log alert filters owned by log_watcher.

tools.name: list_excludes
tools.description: List the canonical dynamic log exclusions currently stored by log_watcher. Use this before adding or removing an exclusion.

tools.name: add_exclude
tools.description: Add one dynamic log exclusion. This can hide real incidents. Prefer a narrow distinctive substring, inspect existing exclusions first, and explain the verified false positive in reason. Text, host, process, and pid values use substring matching.

value.description: Case-sensitive substring whose matching log candidates should be excluded.

reason.description: Why this pattern is a verified false positive and safe to suppress.

tools.name: remove_exclude
tools.description: Remove one exact dynamic exclusion entry so matching logs become eligible for alerts again. Inspect current exclusions first and explain the reason for removal.

reason.description: Why this exclusion should be removed.
